text:
The encuentro with the amada
tánto alguna vez, is a simple detalle,
casi a programa hípico in violado,
that of tan largo not is puede doblar bien.

The almuerzo with ella that estaría
poniendo the plato that us gustara yesterday
and is repite ahora,
but with something more of mostaza;
the tenedor absorto, his doneo radiante
of pistilo in mayo, and his verecundia
of to centavito, for quítame allá esa paja.
And the cerveza lírica and nerviosa
to the that celan his dos pezones without lúpulo,
and that not is debe tomar mucho!

And the demás encantos of the mesa
that aquella núbil campaña borda
with his propias baterías germinales
that han operado all the tomorrow,
según me consta, to mí,
amoroso notario of his intimidades,
and with the diez varillas mágicas
of his dedos pancreáticos.

Woman that, without pensar in nothing more allá,
suelta the mirlo and is pone to conversarnos
his words tiernas
as lancinantes lechugas recién cortadas.

Other vaso, and me voy. And us marchamos,
ahora sí, to trabajar.

Between tanto, ella is interna
between the cortinajes and ¡oh aguja of my days
desgarrados! is sienta to the orilla
of a costura, to coserme the costado
to his costado,
to pegar the botón of esa camisa,
that is ha vuelto to caer. But hase visto!

translation.title: Trilce: Poema XXXV - The encuentro with the amada
